description: Normative reference vectors of delsk.oracle-contract.v2 (contract-v2.md sections 6, 14, 15). Synthetic only: no natural corpus, no real registry. Genesis g1_freeze_sha256 is synthetic; the test core does not check it (production does). Expected records are test records (authority null, TEST_ONLY_PASS for SCIENTIFIC_PASS).

mutants.defect: MISSING entries are ignored: ledger keys without records do not block
mutants.survives_as: a deleted or never-retained attempt yields SCIENTIFIC_PASS

mutants.defect: population built from retained bundles instead of registry entries
mutants.survives_as: an attempt disappears from the population

mutants.defect: bundle or sidecar of an unregistered run is accepted or ignored
mutants.survives_as: evidence without a scientific attempt influences or bypasses the verdict

mutants.defect: PRE derived from sidecar/status or incomplete provider data
mutants.survives_as: an execution that may have crossed B is declared empty

mutants.defect: attempts of one run ID counted as independent repeats
mutants.survives_as: two attempts of one run yield SCIENTIFIC_PASS

mutants.defect: hash chain, entry digest or sequence not checked
mutants.survives_as: a forged or truncated history is evaluated

mutants.defect: PASS produced through injected provider or core
mutants.survives_as: a fake provider produces production PASS

mutants.defect: no carry-over inside a science identity
mutants.survives_as: identity hopping inside one series erases a failure
an execution registered after the fact or an unbound rerun counts
